Then a clause covers all iff the union of true-sets = all iff the intersection of the false-sets = ∅ iff not all f(i) are equal. Removing literal i leaves F \ {f(i)}; nonempty intersection iff |F \ {f(i)}| ≤ 1, i.e., F has exactly 2 distinct values and one of them appears only once. So minimal clauses = pairs with distinct f values, or... e.g., F = {1,1,2} → remove a '1' → {2} → intersection = {w_2} ≠ ∅ ✓ essential; remove the '2' → {1,1} → intersection = {w_1} ≠ ∅ ✓ essential. import sys, json, random, time, ctypes, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from gen import rand_predicate

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 3)

def build(seed, ntrain=10000, nq=64, napp=256, width=4, npred=32):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    # 4 fields x 4 slots = 16 cells, binary domains -> 65536 windows
    fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':rng.choice(['count','id','flag','size','time']),
             'domain':[0,1] if rng.random()<0.8 else [0,1,2]} for i in range(4)]
    slots=4
    cell_doms=[f['domain'] for _ in range(slots) for f in fields]
    total=1
    for d in cell_doms: total*=len(d)
    preds=[rand_predicate(rng, fields, slots) for _ in range(npred)]
    # sample train from a random subset of the universe
    keep = rng.sample(range(total), max(1,total//2))
    train=[]
    for _ in range(ntrain):
        u=rng.choice(keep)
        vals=[]; rem=u
        for c in range(len(cell_doms)-1,-1,-1):
            r=len(cell_doms[c]); vals.append(cell_doms[c][rem%r]); rem//=r
        vals=vals[::-1]
        train.append([list(vals[s*4:(s+1)*4]) for s in range(slots)])
    approved=[sorted(rng.sample(range(npred), rng.randint(1,width))) for _ in range(napp)]
    seen=set(); approved=[c for c in approved if not (tuple(c) in seen or seen.add(tuple(c)))]
    nf=4
    queries=[]
    for _ in range(nq):
        cells=slots*nf
        order=list(range(cells)); rng.shuffle(order)
        nfixed=rng.randint(0, min(3, cells-1))
        fixed=[{'ref':[c//nf, fields[c%nf]['name']], 'value': rng.choice(fields[c%nf]['domain'])} for c in order[:nfixed]]
        t=order[nfixed]
        queries.append({'fixed':fixed,'target':[t//nf, fields[t%nf]['name']],
                        'prefix': rng.choice(['','0','1','10','01','9','123','000','1000000','55','0123456'])})
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':width,'train':train,
            'approved':approved,'queries':queries}, total

jobs=[]
tot=0
for i in range(6):
    job,total = build(100+i)
    tot+=total
    jobs.append(job)
print('total universe windows:', tot)
batch={'jobs':jobs}
payload=json.dumps(batch).encode()
print('input bytes:', len(payload))
t0=time.time()
outs=[compile_job(j) for j in jobs]
el=time.time()-t0
text=json.dumps({'results':outs},separators=(',',':'))
print(f'engine time {el:.2f}s  output bytes {len(text)}  rules {[len(o["rules"]) for o in outs]}')
EOF
